observations.behavior: Adds a helper to generate a deterministic row ID for audit log entries, using a SHA256 hash of the row contents. This is necessary because audit events do not carry their own stable identifier.
observations.code_quote: # Audit events carry no id of their own, so the transport hashes each row's contents into
observations.posthog_connection: This supports the warehouse ingestion of Docker Hub audit logs, allowing PostHog to store and query audit events without relying on an external ID. The hash becomes the primary key, and the implementation is described in comments.

observations.behavior: Adds an incremental field and a partition key to the Docker Hub audit log configuration, and marks the endpoint as org-scoped.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration enables incremental ingestion of Docker Hub audit logs, allowing PostHog to resync only new events rather than performing a full refresh. The partition key and incremental field support warehouse optimization and reduce ingestion cost.

observations.behavior: Adds a new endpoint configuration for Docker Hub org members and org groups, and marks them as org-scoped.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration enables PostHog to ingest Docker Hub org members and org groups, which are only available for organization-level access. The org-scoped flag indicates that the warehouse ingestion will require an organization-level token, not a personal account token.
